spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of K ephalaia Core Text ( ¶7– 15 )

---

** ¶7. ** It is proper for you to perce ive this in ward ly. The external tru ths called "the comprehensive doctrine " are the five fac ulties of spiritual perception that bring to full ness the organized form of the Divine Human — the fully regenerated person . These fac ulties were purified and made transparent by the descent of Divine infl ux into the mind .

**¶8.** In contrast, what are called "fragments ": the fragments are the wisdom that has been consumed and scattered by fals ity . This wisdom is compounded with and entangled in the whole di sordered form of the fallen mind — in the dominant falsities of the intellectual regions , which rule throughout all the structures of the natural understanding . And its remaining rad iance is that which still illumin ates and shows itself in the kn owledges held capt ive in the chain of merely natural order , and in the active persu asions that govern hab itual thought . And likewise these fragments of wisdom are entangled in the three degrees of the natural mind below — above the sust aining principle at the lowest degree, and in the sens ual plane beneath it . These are called " fragments" because they have been sh attered from their whol eness.

**¶9.** But the "comprehensive tru ths that are worn through and torn apart," which we have declared — this is the living power of good and truth from the Divine that has become entangled in the natural mind. It is reaped, sev ered, and consumed . It is overpowered by the five corpor eal loves — the loves of self , the world , domin ion, possession , and sens ual pleasure — which creep and spread from one state of the will to another.

**¶10.** On the other hand, what we have called "the li kenesses and the great t attered cov erings" — these are the three comprehensive external truths of understanding , love , and truth themselves . These the Lord in His operative presence assumed as outer means upon His acting form . By means of them He disposed all things in the mind into order. By means of them also He emptied the containing forms of the natural mind — He swept them of their fals ities and laid them bare before the sust aining principle at the foundation of all existence .

**¶11.** Conversely, what we have called "the resid ual substances " — this is the power of good that remains lat ent in all things of the lowest natural mind . It rises up in the inter iors of every natural state, gathering itself together and pouring itself forth upon all things, seeking to return .

**¶12.** And then, what we have called the "Cross of Wisdom " — this is the bound and suffering state of Divine truth throughout the natural plane , in what is bar ren and in what is recept ive alike . * [The damaged text res ists full translation, but the correspondence is clear: the "Light Cross" is wisdom cruc ified — Divine truth fixed and suspended in the whole natural order, present in every state whether it receives truth or lacks it. ]*

**¶13.** Also, what is called "the counsel of life" is the Divine calling and the will 's obedience to it. It moves within all the powers and faculties we have named. It awakens them, gives them rest and peace , and imp els them toward their proper activity .

**¶14.** What is called "the soul that is sl ain" — that which is killed, oppressed, and destroyed — this is the power of good that res ides in works , in natural goods, and in interior tru ths still enclosed in their cov erings. These shall be threshed, torn away , and cut down, and they give their substance over to the corpor eal loves that feed upon them. Further: natural good , should it become empt ied of all truth ; and external truth , should it become prof aned and torn — these per ish. And again, even this is a portion of the whole innoc ence that is slain and destroyed ; since even this entire portion of the Divine life within them, the corpor eal loves contin ually kill.

**¶15.** For all these names are , in their origin , a single reality — a single wisdom proce eding from the Divine since the beginning, and it sh ines as one light . But this wisdom was divided into all these distinct states in the first conflict between good and evil. It became fixed in all these altered forms and received these many names. Yet if now all these varieties are laid bare and stripped of every appearance they have assumed , and parted from every name they have received, they will gather together and constitute a single form and a single name — unalt erable and unchangeable forever — in the celest ial state of their first origin , from which they were sent forth against the power of hell .

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: "It is proper for you to understand this. The garments that are named 'great garment' are the five intellectuals that make perfect the body of the Pillar of Glory, the Perfect Man. They were purified by the coming of the Ambassador.

"However, the 'great worn and torn apart garments', which we have proclaimed, is this entangled living power. It is reaped, cut, and devoured. It is overpowered by the five worlds of the flesh, which creep as they move from place to place.

"On the other hand, [these] we have termed the 'images and the great tattered clothes' [that we have proclaimed: they] are the three great garments of the wind, the fire, and the water. These the Living Spirit cloaked upon his body. With them he set in order things in the universe. With them also he emptied the vessels. He swept them out and laid them bare in front of the Porter at the foundation of all things.

"Conversely, '[the ele]ments', we have called them this name, are this power that remains in all things below. It rises up in the wombs of all the earths, gathering together, and pouring forth upon all things.
"And then, the '[Light] Cross' [we have termed] this bound 'light power'. It [is set in] all [things] upon the earth, in the dry and the moist.
"Also, the one named the 'counsel of life' is the summons and the obedience. It moves in all these powers that we have named. It awakens them, gives them ease, and drives them to their movement.

"For all these names [that we have proclaimed] are a single [power of light;] since the beginning, it [was one] as it enlightens; but they separated into all these parts in this first contest. They became set in all these altered forms, and these many names. Of course, if now all these varieties are laid bare, and stripped of all these appearances, and parted from all these names; they will gather together and make a single form, and a single name, unaltered and unchangeable for ever in the land of their first essence, from which they were sent forth against the enemy."

"In contrast, the ones named 'rag': the rags are the devoured enlightening power. It is compounded and entangled in the body of the universe in the rulers who are above, who exist in all the firmaments. Also, its shine is that which lights up and is displayed in the stars of the chain and the powers of the course. And likewise, these rags that are entangled in these three earths below, above the head of the Porter [and also] on the earth that is under the Porter. These are named the 'rags', because [they have been] set [apart and torn from their wholeness.]

"The one named 'the soul that is slain', which is killed, oppressed and murdered; it is this power of fruit, vegetables and seeds. They shall be threshed, plucked and cut down; and they give nourishment to the worlds of the flesh. Further: the wood should it be dry, and the garment should it become ragged, will perish. Again, it is [a pa]rt of this entire soul that is slain and killed; since also even this whole part of it they kill [and devour without ceasing.]
